facts.fact: A World Bank staff blog states that in Namibia all vital events are centralised in a single database, the National Population Register (NPRS), with no separate identity system, and gives birth and death registration coverage of 88 and 94 per cent; no date is given, so the published date is used.

A World Bank staff blog states that e-birth and e-death reporting platforms run in almost all health facilities, police mortuaries and civil registry offices, enabling real-time reporting to the NPRS; it gives no count and no date, so the published date is used.
